title: Enterprise Management Incentives (EMI): end of year return template and guidance notes
text:
To complete your end of year template for Enterprise Management Incentives ( EMI ) either:

 • use HMRC’s end of year return template

 • create your own template using the technical note

 Use the guidance notes to help you fill in specific sections of the template.

 After completing your template, you can:

 • avoid delays in your submissions by  checking your files for formatting errors 

 • submit your return
changeNote: Added the new end of year template, guidance notes and technical notes for April 2027.
